channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Monitor cost anomalies directly in Billing and Cost Management Dashboards with the new Detected Anomalies widget
item.description: Today, AWS Billing and Cost Management (BCM) announces support for the Detected Anomalies widget in BCM Dashboards. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Direct Connect announces flat-rate pricing for dedicated connections
item.description: AWS Direct Connect announces flat-rate pricing for 10G and 100G dedicated connections AWS Direct Connect provides dedicated network connectivity from on-premises environments to AWS. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Billing Conductor now supports custom rates and usage tier pricing configurations
item.description: AWS Billing Conductor now lets you define custom rate pricing for AWS services, including defining custom usage tiers to configure rates by the desired usage volume. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports instance preference lists for training and processing jobs
item.description: Today, Amazon SageMaker AI announces instance preference lists for training and processing jobs, making it easier and faster to find compute capacity for your workloads. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Analyze your CloudTrail events using natural language in Amazon Q Console
item.description: AWS CloudTrail, a service that records API activity across your AWS account for security auditing, compliance, and operational troubleshooting, now integrates with Amazon Q Console to help you investigate your AWS account activity using… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now enables agents to bid on preferred shifts
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now enables agents to bid on preferred shifts, giving them more control over their work schedules. Schedulers first establish agent ranking either by uploading a CSV file or generating a randomized ranking. (1 source: aws)
